say:1:1035001001:1.text: I was dead asleep just now, but it sounded like someone might have rushed past.
say:1:1035001001:1.source_cn: 刚才我睡得正香，恍惚间好像感觉到什么人在赶路。

say:2:1035001002:1.text: I think the person sounded anxious... shouting something as they ran.
say:2:1035001002:1.source_cn: 他好像很着急，一边赶路一边喊着什么。

say:3:1035001003:1.text: They must have been moving fast because I was woken up by the wind they kicked up!
say:3:1035001003:1.source_cn: 那人定是脚下生风，都把我吹醒了！

say:4:1035001004:1.text: But when I opened my eyes, no one was around... isn't that odd?
say:4:1035001004:1.source_cn: 可我睁开眼，周围却连个人影都没有……你说怪不？
